title: Đề luyện Nói VSTEP — Recall RV0823 (Part 1 + 2 + 3)

questions.content:
speaking — Part 1

Part 1: Social Interaction You will answer questions about two topics. Answer each question naturally. Topic 1 - Farms 1. Do you often see farms where you live, and what do you usually see there? 2. What do you like most about farms? 3. Do you think farms make an important contribution to the economy? Topic 2 - Bags 1. Do you usually carry a bag when you go out? 2. What do you usually keep in your bag? 3. Do you prefer plastic bags or canvas (cloth) bags? Why?

speaking — Part 2

Situation: A close friend of yours is staying in hospital and you would like to buy them a gift. You are considering the following options: 1. A bunch of flowers 2. Colored pens and a drawing notebook 3. Some healthy snacks Which one would you choose? Why?

speaking — Part 3

Topic: Leadership plays an important role in the success of any team or organization. Ideas: - Sets a clear direction and vision - Motivates and unites people to work together - Makes hard decisions and takes responsibility - Your own idea (for example, develops future leaders) Further questions: 1. What qualities make someone a good leader? 2. Can leadership skills be taught, or are people born with them? 3. How does poor leadership affect a team or organization?
